items.title_en: CBAM accreditation update: seven bodies accept third-country applications, previously five
items.title_original: State-of-play CBAM accreditation
items.summary_zh: 欧委会两页进展表现列24家国家认可机构同意提供CBAM认可、18家准备受理申请、7家同意认可第三国申请人且已开始受理；相比9月29日版本，准备受理及已受理第三国申请机构分别由16、5增至18、7。第三国受理机构为法国COFRAC、希腊ESYD、意大利Accredia、荷兰RvA、波兰PCA、斯洛伐克SNAS、瑞典Swedac。罗马尼亚RENAR、斯洛文尼亚SA仍标为未准备受理，分别备注2026年10月、11月，不能据月份认定已启动。荷兰及瑞典另有分别涉及土耳其TURKAK、乌克兰NAAU的协议备注。
items.summary_en: The updated Commission table lists 24 bodies offering CBAM accreditation, 18 ready for applications and seven agreeing to accredit and already accepting third-country applicants, versus 16 and five in the 29 September version. The seven are COFRAC, ESYD, Accredia, RvA, PCA, SNAS and Swedac. RENAR and SA remain marked not ready, with October and November 2026 notes respectively; the notes do not establish commencement. RvA and Swedac have agreement notes concerning TURKAK and NAAU.
items.impact_zh: 中国核验机构可向上述国家认可机构确认申请资格、程序和适用条件；钢厂选服务商时应查有效认可证书、钢铁产品／活动范围和官方名录。本表描述受理渠道，不证明特定检测公司已获认可或覆盖全部CBAM行业，签约前应留存证书及范围证据。
items.impact_en: Chinese verifier applicants can confirm eligibility and procedures with these bodies. Mills should check valid certificates, steel activity scope and official listings before contracting. Application readiness does not prove that any individual company is accredited across all CBAM sectors.

items.title_zh: 美国对华定尺碳钢板第五次日落复审终裁：撤令可能导致倾销延续
items.title_en: US fifth sunset review finds dumping likely to recur for Chinese cut-to-length carbon steel plate
items.title_original: Certain Cut-to-Length Carbon Steel Plate From the People's Republic of China and the Russian Federation: Final Results of the Expedited Fifth Sunset Reviews of the Antidumping Duty Orders
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部第五次快速日落复审终裁（A-570-849；91 FR 63265）认定，撤销对中国和俄罗斯定尺碳钢板反倾销令可能导致倾销继续或再现；可能继续或再现的加权平均倾销幅度最高为中国128.59%、俄罗斯185.00%。由于没有被调查方提交实质答复，商务部采用120天快速复审程序；结果自2026年10月5日起适用。
items.summary_en: Commerce's expedited fifth sunset-review results (A-570-849; 91 FR 63265) find that revoking the China and Russia CTL-plate AD orders would likely lead to continuation or recurrence of dumping. Margins likely to prevail are up to 128.59% for China and 185.00% for Russia. No respondent interested party filed a substantive response, so Commerce used the 120-day expedited procedure. The results apply from 5 October 2026.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：128.59%是日落复审中的“可能继续或再现”幅度，不是所有中国出口商自本公告起统一适用的新现金保证金率。本公告支持维持现有反倾销令，但仍应跟踪USITC损害复审及后续续令公告；涉美定尺板业务应继续按企业适用税率报价，不应假设措施即将撤销。
items.impact_en: Assessment: 128.59% is the sunset-review margin likely to prevail, not a new uniform cash-deposit rate for every Chinese exporter. The finding supports continuation of the order, subject to the injury-side review and subsequent continuation notice. US CTL-plate business should keep using company-specific applicable rates and not assume the order will lapse.

items.title_zh: 欧盟公布2026年第三季度CBAM证书价格：82.32欧元
items.title_en: EU publishes Q3 2026 CBAM certificate price of €82.32
items.title_original: Q3 2026 CBAM Certificate price now available!
items.summary_zh: 欧委会10月5日公布2026年第三季度CBAM证书价格为每张82.32欧元；第二季度为75.28欧元，环比上升约9.4%。季度价格按欧盟碳排放配额拍卖成交价加权平均计算，适用于对应季度进口CBAM商品的隐含排放；2026年证书从2027年2月起在统一中央平台购买。
items.summary_en: On 5 October the Commission published the Q3 2026 CBAM certificate price at €82.32, about 9.4% above Q2's €75.28. The quarterly price is the weighted average of EU ETS auction clearing prices and applies to embedded emissions in CBAM goods imported during the relevant quarter; 2026 certificates become purchasable on the common central platform from February 2027.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：钢铁出口商应把82.32欧元作为第三季度对应证书的官方价格输入，与欧盟进口商更新碳成本测算和合同调价假设；它不是钢材吨税，也不能脱离经核验的产品隐含排放、免费分配调整和已支付碳价直接换算应缴额。
items.impact_en: Assessment: use €82.32 as the official certificate-price input for Q3 and update carbon-cost and contract assumptions with EU importers. It is not a per-tonne steel tariff and cannot determine liability without verified embedded emissions, free-allocation adjustment and eligible carbon prices already paid.
items.source_excerpt: 05 Oct 2026 Q3 2026 CBAM Certificate price now available! Each 2026 quarterly price is calculated by the Commission in the first calendar week after the quarter ends, based on publicly available EU ETS auction information.
items.coverage: Official DG TAXUD price table and methodology page checked on 5 October 2026.

items.title_en: US Commerce correction clarifies retroactive suspension for China-origin butt-weld pipe fittings processed in Vietnam
items.title_original: Certain Carbon Steel Butt-Weld Pipe Fittings From the People's Republic of China: Notice of Court Decision Not in Harmony With Final Covered Merchandise Determination and Notice of Amended Covered Merchandise Determination Pursuant to Court Decision; Correction
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部10月2日发布更正（A-570-814；91 FR 62700），补入8月28日公告遗漏的追溯执行段落。对在中国形成粗坯、在越南完成第二或第三阶段加工且物理特征相同的相关产品：已暂停的条目继续暂停并适用相应现金保证金；尚未暂停且未清算的条目，2022年9月26日及以后进口的须暂停清算并缴纳保证金；2021年11月4日之后、2022年9月26日之前进口且仍未清算的条目亦同。该认定按同一国家的出口商或进口商层面适用。
items.summary_en: Commerce's 2 October correction (A-570-814; 91 FR 62700) adds omitted retroactive implementation language to the 28 August notice. For China-formed rough shapes completed through second or third production stages in Vietnam and sharing the relevant physical characteristics, CBP is to continue existing suspensions and apply cash deposits; suspend still-unliquidated entries on or after 26 September 2022; and also suspend still-unliquidated entries after 4 November 2021 but before 26 September 2022, at the applicable rate. The finding applies on a country-wide exporter or importer basis.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：更正没有公布统一新税率，但显著扩大了需要追溯核对的未清算条目范围。相关出口商、越南加工商和美国进口商应立即按两个日期区间筛查历史未清算进口，核对保证金及海关指令，并保存粗坯物理特征、加工和原产链证据。
items.impact_en: Assessment: the correction sets no uniform new rate but materially clarifies the historical unliquidated entries subject to suspension. Exporters, Vietnamese processors and US importers should screen entries against both date windows, verify cash-deposit and CBP instructions, and preserve evidence on rough-shape characteristics, processing and origin.

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) published notice to the public in the Federal Register of August 28, 2026 that the U.S. Court of International Trade's (CIT) final judgment was not in harmony with Commerce's covered merchandise inquiry (CMI) determination. Specifically, Commerce amended the CMI determination to find that products cut to length and formed into the rough shape of certain carbon steel butt-weld pipe fittings (butt-weld pipe fittings) in the People's Republic of China (China) represent "unfinished" fittings, which are covered by the scope of the Order, and that when such products are further processed in the Socialist Republic of Vietnam (Vietnam), they remain subject to the antidumping (AD) order on butt- weld pipe fittings from China. This notice did not provide clear notice to parties that the liquidation of entries of these unfinished fittings will be retroactively suspended.

items.summary_zh: WTO争端解决机构于2026年9月25日就俄罗斯诉欧盟案DS639成立专家组，审查欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）及俄罗斯所称欧盟排放交易体系下的出口补贴是否符合WTO义务。俄罗斯于2025年5月12日请求磋商、2026年7月10日请求设组；中国等成员保留第三方权利。专家组成立只是争端程序启动，尚无裁决。
items.summary_en: On 25 September 2026 the WTO DSB established a panel in DS639, Russia's challenge to the EU CBAM package and an alleged export subsidy under the EU ETS. Russia requested consultations on 12 May 2025 and a panel on 10 July 2026. China and other members reserved third-party rights. Panel establishment begins adjudication; no ruling has been issued.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：DS639不会自动暂停CBAM，欧盟现行申报、授权申报人和证书义务仍应照常准备。中国钢企可跟踪中国作为第三方提交的法律主张和后续报告，但当前不应据此延后碳数据、核证或客户合规安排。
items.impact_en: Assessment: DS639 does not automatically suspend CBAM. Existing EU reporting, authorised-declarant and certificate preparations should continue. Chinese steel exporters should monitor China's third-party submissions and later reports, but should not delay emissions-data, verification or customer-compliance work.

On 19 March 2026, the government announced a new steel trade measure , taking effect from 1 July 2026. This measure has been implemented using powers in the Taxation (Cross Border Trade) Act 2018 , as amended. The government has carried out a programme of intensive industry engagement since the announcement. We have also engaged closely with the European Union ( EU ) ahead of their new steel trade measure coming into effect and agreed an approach that reflects the UK and EU ’s highly interconnected supply chains. items.title_zh: EU ETS：2025合规表已发布，生铁／钢生产记录完成限定范围核验
items.title_en: EU ETS: 2025 compliance workbook published; scoped iron/steel check completed
items.title_original: EU ETS – Publication of surrender and compliance data
items.summary_zh: 官方登记册于10月5日列出2025合规表。本轮读取XLSX的Export Worksheet及activity codes工作表，筛选COMPLIANCE_STATUS_LATEST_YEAR=2025、MAIN_ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE为5或24（生铁或钢生产），得到180条记录：合规代码A为175条、B为4条、C为1条。计数仅覆盖上述活动与年份筛选，不代表整个钢铁价值链；TOTAL_VERIFIED_EMISSIONS与TOTAL_SURRENDERED_ALLOWANCES字段不在本条中作为2025年度总量使用。代码含义与具体异常原因仍需结合EUTL说明和主管机关记录核实。
items.summary_en: The Registry listed the 2025 workbook on 5 October. Reading both worksheets and filtering latest compliance year=2025 and main activity code 5 or 24 (pig iron or steel) yields 180 records: code A 175, B 4, C 1. This is a scoped record count, not a whole steel value-chain total. Total emissions/surrender fields are not treated as annual 2025 totals. Code meanings and case-specific causes require EUTL guidance and authority records.
items.impact_zh: 这份表可支持核对欧盟钢铁装置的合规记录；不能据代码分布推导中国钢材CBAM税额、装置年度排放强度或行业违法比例。对合作装置逐一核对登记册标识、年份和官方解释，再判断是否需要补充尽调。
items.impact_en: Use the workbook to check EU installation records. Code counts do not establish Chinese steel CBAM charges, annual emissions intensity or an industry breach rate. Verify installation IDs, years and official interpretations before further due diligence.
items.source_excerpt: The Commission will publish the available surrender and compliance data 2025 on October 6, 2026, at the latest.
items.follow_up: 已完成发布入口和代码5/24、最新合规年份2025的限定计数核验；后续如需年度排放或装置风险结论，另查年度核验排放表、EUTL代码解释及主管机关记录。
items.coverage: 2026-10-09已读9月25日通知、登记册报告列表和10月5日官方XLSX两工作表；核对字段、活动代码及上述180条记录的代码分布，未核验各装置异常原因，未计算行业年度排放或清缴总量。
